entities.summary: Scott Michael Disick also known by his self styled title Scott Michael Disick, Lord Disick, is an American media personality and socialite widely known for his role as a main cast member on Keeping Up with the Kardashians and its spinoffs. Disick's popularity on Keeping Up with the Kardashians led to the development of a house flipping show, Flip It Like Disick, that aired on E!. In addition to starring on reality shows, he has pursued multiple business ventures, including starting the clothing brand Talentless, investing in nightclubs, and running multiple vitamin companies.
